info.title: API.SH: CarMax
info.description: The CarMax API from API.SH: public CarMax data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

tags.description: Your balance, usage, logs and past responses. Free.

401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

get.description:
CarMax's search suggestions for typed text: makes, models and features, each with its category and search segment.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/carmax-autocomplete

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One CarMax car: price and price drop, VIN, year, make, model, trim, mileage, colors, engine, transmission, drivetrain, MPG, fuel tank, every feature by category, packages, highlights, history (accidents, owners, prior use), warranties, generation, store and lot, the model's pros and cons, and listing dates. Sold cars answer 404.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/carmax-car

parameters.name: stock_number
parameters.description: CarMax stock number (stock_number in search), or a carmax.com/car/<number> link in `url`. Required unless latest=true.

parameters.name: latest
parameters.description: true = the first car of a search with the make/model/filters params below, instead of a stock number.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

features.name: Power Seat(s)
features.description: Set and adjust your seats to the perfect setting.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

get.description:
CarMax customer reviews of a model, all years or one year: total, average, rating breakdown, top likes and dislikes, and 10 reviews per page with rating, title, pros and cons by topic, recommendation, helpful votes, the reviewer's nickname, name and city/state as the site shows them, and the car's year, mileage and time owned. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/carmax-reviews

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: Model year (all years when left out).

parameters.name: rating
parameters.description: Only reviews with this many stars (1-5).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Used cars in CarMax's nationwide inventory, 24 per page (up to 48 with `limit`): price, price drops, mileage, VIN, specs, MPG, features, highlights, customer rating, the store and transfer (shipping) details. Filter by make, model, keyword, any facet segment (`filters`: colors, body types, drivetrain, fuel, features, packages, doors, size...), year, price and mileage ranges, highway MPG, ZIP and radius. Every response also lists the site's filters with values, segments and counts. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/carmax-search

parameters.name: zip
parameters.description: ZIP code the distances and nearest store are based on (default 90210).

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: Miles from the ZIP, or nationwide (default: nationwide, including cars that can be shipped).

parameters.name: local_only
parameters.description: true = only cars at stores near the ZIP (no transfers).

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A carmax.com search link (/cars/...) used as-is instead of the filters.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Store id from /carmax/v1/stores, or a carmax.com/stores/<id> link in `url`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Every CarMax store with id, name, city, state and coordinates, optionally for one state, plus the number of stores in each state. Use an id with /carmax/v1/store.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/carmax-stores

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
